summary: String functions clean up and reshape text.
points: UPPER and LOWER change capital letters, and LENGTH counts characters.
SUBSTR(text, start, length) takes part of a string, counting from 1. Leave out the length to take the rest.
|| joins text together. Don't use + for this: it treats text as numbers.
Joining anything to NULL gives NULL.

example.explanation: This makes the first letter a capital and every other letter lowercase.
